verdict.rationale: Fin's own site documents an official Fin CLI built for AI-native use. AI coding agents can be pointed at it to set up Fin on a website and configure the Intercom helpdesk from the coding environment. The evidence is a single marketing-level mention, so how deep the CLI goes is not shown. Missing for 10: command reference or install docs, scope of supported operations, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Point your AI coding Agent at the Fin CLI to set up Fin on your website and configure your Intercom helpdesk — all without leaving your coding environment.
